motifs.name: material edge with activity tiebreak
motifs.description: The side to move has more total piece value than the opponent, or with equal material attacks more enemy pieces than the opponent attacks.

motifs.name: healthier pawn structure
motifs.description: The side to move has a clearly sounder pawn structure, with at least two fewer isolated, doubled, or backward pawns than the opponent.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'healthier pawn structure'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a clearly sounder pawn structure, with at least two fewer isolated, doubled, or backward pawns than the opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn

    def weaknesses(color):
        pawns = list(board.pieces(chess.PAWN, color))
        files = [0] * 8
        for sq in pawns:
            files[chess.square_file(sq)] += 1
        d = 1 if color == chess.WHITE else -1
        w = 0
        for sq in pawns:
            f = chess.square_file(sq)
            r = chess.square_rank(sq)
            if files[f] > 1:
                w += 1
            left = files[f - 1] if f > 0 else 0
            right = files[f + 1] if f < 7 else 0
            if left == 0 and right == 0:
                w += 1
                continue
            adj = [chess.square_rank(q) for q in pawns
                   if q != sq and abs(chess.square_file(q) - f) == 1]
            if adj and all((qr - r) * d > 0 for qr in adj):
                rs = r + d
                rg = r + 2 * d
                if 0 <= rs <= 7 and 0 <= rg <= 7:
                    for gf in (f - 1, f + 1):
                        if 0 <= gf <= 7:
                            p = board.piece_at(chess.square(gf, rg))
                            if p is not None and p.piece_type == chess.PAWN and p.color != color:
                                w += 1
                                break
        return w

    return weaknesses(not stm) >= weaknesses(stm) + 2

motifs.name: development lead on even terms
motifs.description: With material roughly equal, the side to move has a clear development lead: at least two more units of development (minor pieces off their back rank plus a king tucked off the central file) than the opponent.

motifs.name: enemy-half pawn space edge
motifs.description: The side to move's pawns attack at least three more distinct squares on the opponent's half of the board than the opponent's pawns attack on the side-to-move's half, reflecting a clear space advantage.

motifs.name: accumulated positional pluses score
motifs.description: The side to move has at least three points of positional advantages such as the bishop pair, pinned enemy pieces, advanced passed pawns, rooks on open files, and the safer king.

motifs.name: bishop pair advantage
motifs.description: The side to move owns the bishop pair (two or more bishops) while the opponent has at most one bishop, a lasting positional edge.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'bishop pair advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move owns the bishop pair (two or more bishops) while the opponent has at most one bishop, a lasting positional edge.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    mine = len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm))
    theirs = len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp))
    return mine >= 2 and theirs < 2

motifs.name: check based double attack
motifs.description: With material not already favorable, the side to move has mate in one or a checking move that also leaves an enemy non-pawn piece with more attackers than defenders.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'check based double attack'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'With material not already favorable, the side to move has mate in one or a checking move that also leaves an enemy non-pawn piece with more attackers than defenders.'
import chess

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    values = (0, 100, 300, 300, 500, 900, 0)
    own = sum(values[p.piece_type] for p in board.piece_map().values() if p.color == stm)
    their = sum(values[p.piece_type] for p in board.piece_map().values() if p.color == opp)
    if own - their > 200:
        return False
    skipped = (chess.PAWN, chess.KING)
    for move in board.legal_moves:
        if not board.gives_check(move):
            continue
        board.push(move)
        if board.is_checkmate():
            board.pop()
            return True
        hit = False
        for sq, piece in board.piece_map().items():
            if piece.color != opp or piece.piece_type in skipped:
                continue
            attackers = board.attackers(stm, sq)
            if attackers and len(attackers) > len(board.attackers(opp, sq)):
                hit = True
                break
        board.pop()
        if hit:
            return True
    return False

motifs.name: activity compensation without material edge
motifs.description: With equal or less material, the side to move controls many more squares than the opponent, showing superior piece activity.

motifs.name: enemy king stranded in center
motifs.description: With queens still on the board, the opponent king is stranded on a central file without safe castling escape while the side to move has its own king tucked away on a flank.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'enemy king stranded in center'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'With queens still on the board, the opponent king is stranded on a central file without safe castling escape while the side to move has its own king tucked away on a flank.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    if not board.pieces(chess.QUEEN, stm) and not board.pieces(chess.QUEEN, opp):
        return False
    ok = board.king(opp)
    okf = chess.square_file(ok)
    okr = chess.square_rank(ok)
    back_rank = 7 if opp else 0
    if okf in (3, 4):
        central = True
    elif okf in (2, 5):
        central = not (okf == 2 and okr == back_rank) and not board.has_castling_rights(opp)
    else:
        central = False
    if not central:
        return False
    skf = chess.square_file(board.king(stm))
    return skf <= 2 or skf >= 5
